source.title: 08-11 Meeting: ADVO — Power Mac Center Spotlight 3 — Wingman Tournament App, Licensing/Ownership, HRIS-First Roadmap and Hosting
speaker: Speaker 1
Speaker 2
Speaker 3
Speaker 4

summary: The client owner (Speaker 2) describes a badminton tournament app she wants exclusively for her Wingman group: player list, pairing, court schedule, captain-entered scores, rankings, and a shareable output, replacing the Excel she built herself (five courts, class A/B/C, 1-to-31 scoring, equal rest); ADVO asks her to send the Excel files to build the cards. She recounts paying about 6,000 euro (8,000 something total) for the license of an existing window-fabrication software whose Indian vendor struggles with customization, states her principle that the software must be hers and that the database may be wiped, and ADVO volunteers to build it instead. She lists further modules she wants: a Salesforce-like CRM with modifiable pipeline, real estate (lease, maintenance, purchase, title checklist), cars/motorcycles (LTO renewals, service), internal service requests, and role-gated access so fabricators and installers see only their project data; her attendance and accomplishment reports currently run on Telegram. ADVO (Speaker 3) positions an HRIS-first roadmap (attendance with accomplishment report plus applicant tracking as basic; sales/production/CRM as advanced) and explains hosting on Supabase at 3K per month covering database, hosting, maintenance and domain, 2GB or 4GB RAM, 100 GB storage, scalable, with data older than the 10-year warranty backed up and deleted. The client recalls a prior 25-to-30 estimate that ADVO calls a rough estimate under review, wants it lowered and tested with biometrics first, and separately asks for website fixes (door animation should open outward), new product assets (SC door, sliding casement, stair glass railing), and a clean non-Chinese product video. Off-topic stretches cover ticketless parking, a fried-chicken franchise offer, and badminton banter. Linked to project 3: the transcript describes window fabricators/installers and matches the FourLinq module set and P3,000/month infra.

fact.claim: The client wants tournament software where she enters a list of players and the schedule runs games of 15 or 30 minutes on all courts simultaneously.
fact.quote: Para siyang ano, may list of players ako ilalagay. So may mga enemy. Ang kita ko naman sa schedule ko eh. Yung schedule ko kasi like 15 minutes. 30 minutes each game. Pero lahat ng chords sabay-sabay.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client's badminton organization runs its tournaments free of charge, including food, so she does not want to charge participants for the app.
fact.quote: Pero ayoko kasi pabayad. Kasi libre lang yun. Kasi yung organization namin, lahat ng nagpo-concept yun doon, libre lang. Pati food, libre lang.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The group already has an app built by someone else and the client does not want to overstep that person, but feels a tournament tool is needed.
fact.quote: Saka may app kami, kaya lang, ayaw ko yung overstep yung gumawa na kami. Wala pang AI lang. Yung app namin, may gumawa na rin eh. Currently, stick siya. Parang ayoko kalitan yung courtesy sa kanya. Pero, feeling ko kailangan na ng tournament.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Players should see rankings and scores in the tournament app.
fact.quote: In a way, yung player nakikita na niya yung ranking. Nakikita niya yung mga scores.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The tournament app is to be used only within Wingman.
fact.quote: Sa Wingman lang.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Scores should be entered by the team captain or lead partner to avoid wrongly recorded scores.
fact.quote: Para iiwas yung, mali yung ka-record yung score eh. Kasi, team captain kung sino kayo yung lead partner. Para maglagay ng score.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: A previous tournament at LIA drew many complaints about scoring.
fact.quote: Nalala mo yung tournament namin sa, Sa LIA. Maraming nagre-reclame po sa scoring nyo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client wants the tournament app exclusive to Wingman so the idea cannot be reused elsewhere.
fact.quote: Pero gusto ko exclusive to Wingman. Para hindi magamit. Kasi idea ko yung ipibigay ko sa kanya.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client paid 6,000 euro to an Indian vendor for existing software and finds the vendor hard to deal with.
fact.quote: Actually, meron nagbigay. Pero nahihirapan akong kausapin. Pag masungit, ayokong kausapin.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client paid 6,000 euro to the existing software vendor.
fact.quote: May binayaran ako 6,000 Euro. Ah, sabi niya naman. Napalagang akawusap doon sa Indian. Indian.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client's position is that once paid, the software is technically hers; a remaining balance of about 1,000 or 700 euro was mentioned.
fact.quote: Basta kung magbabayad, technically, the software is mine, the first time. So, kaya tingnan ng album, okay na. Basta hindi ko nang mabayaran yung bag. Ang bag ay 1,000 euro na lang, o 700.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The original license cost 6,000 euro and the client has paid 8,000 something in total; the software is for window fabrication and she is fine with the whole database being erased as long as the software is hers.
fact.quote: Pero yung original license is 6,000. Binayaan. So, sa akin, kahit isa na, erase mo yung whole database yan. Okay lang. But, ang principle ko lang, I think, kailangan akin. Whether I use it or not, that's still fine.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The existing vendor cannot deliver the customization the client wants, and she is open to ADVO building it instead.
fact.quote: Kung ayaw mo i-customize, eh waw. I think hindi nila kaya. Kami na lang.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO offered to take over building the software the vendor could not customize.
fact.quote: Kami na lang, tita. Ito po yung ano po.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client wants the CRM to work like Salesforce.
fact.quote: Parang yung CRM pa kasi, gusto ko parang sales force. Annual sales force. Meron ka.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Speaker 3 (ADVO) described a ticketless parking venture with plate-number entry and kiosk payment, which his father wants to run as a parking-management business that keeps the transaction revenue.
fact.quote: Kasi gusto ng dad ko gawin itong Parang parking. Magiging manager Na kami ng mga parking. So kami mismo magmamanage, Ng parking. So yung transactions Nila magpapunta sa amin, wala silang Babayaran sa amin.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client wants a real estate module covering leased properties, maintenance, payments, purchases and a title checklist.
fact.quote: Pag-purchase na kami, di ba may titles yan? Kailangan, natatakot ako sa kanila. Bilis na nang bili, pero hindi nila kinoconsider yung network. Nasa amin na ba yung title? At pag wala sa aming title, hindi pa rin consider. So may checklist na, nagawa mo na ba ito?
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client owns many motorcycles and cars and wants LTO renewal tracking in the same single app, for her company's use only.
fact.quote: Yung higher ng thousand LTO renewal. Marami kami motorcycle saka cars. Pero pwede ba sa isang app lang siya? App. Gets mo yun? So parang isa. Pero, Hindi namin balang paggamit sa iba, Kasi kailangan Kami lang na aakit.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Property records need cost and fair market value over a 10-year horizon.
fact.quote: Kailangan may market value siya. May fair market value siya. So ano na yung cost niya? 10 years ang buong pwede yan.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Vehicle service and repair tracking may be a separate module but can be integrated with the rest.
fact.quote: Kailangan ko rin siya service natin. Baka kailangan hiwalay. Sa vehicles. Pwede naman i-integrate siya. I-integrate.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Speaker 3 (ADVO) started programming by building Roblox games at 14 and was paid to build them for others.
fact.quote: So parang nung 14 years old kasi ako, Gumagawa ko nung Roblox game. Parang doon ako natutupad ako mag-book.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client's existing CRM has an open pipeline (lead, qualified, site-based, mentorship, acquisition, purchase) that she has not been able to verify works, plus warranty and service-order sections she has not tested.
fact.quote: May warranty na rin ako. Nandito na rin yung service order ko. Saka warranty. Itong section, hindi ko pa natatest. Post sale? Dadaan may post sale.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client suspects her previous CRM developer built it with AI while claiming otherwise and citing a cousin who never appeared.
fact.quote: Sino developer mo? Kaya pwede ba namin i-meet? Pinsan daw niya pero hindi niya, na-stress siya. Pero wala namang pinsan na lumalabas.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Speaker 1 (ADVO) remarked that the previous developer's tool was just Claude.
fact.quote: Claude lang yan, Claude.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The previous developer asked for around 300,000 for the CRM, while ADVO's price is less than 100,000.
fact.quote: Dapat daw mga ganyan, 300,000. Para sa loob-loob ko, ano ba, AI na ngayon. Anong iti, 300,000? Kami ngayon. Kung hindi niya alam eh, Kilala akong sa inyo. Kami ngayon. Less than 100,000. Masada pa kaming humble.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO stated the system has backups daily and every hour.
fact.quote: Tsaka may backup shot daily, every hour. Sure?
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client's attendance is currently run entirely on Telegram and she is willing to trial the app for attendance.
fact.quote: Yung attendance, pwede ko siya itrya. Pero, gusto ko, kasi bisang ginagamit mo, saka mo lang nalalaman ano yung sequence. Pwede ko. Ang attendance ko, meron ako sarili pa yung conference. Pero attendance ko, maniwala ka, nakatelegram lahat yan.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Staff submit accomplishment reports through a Telegram group, which the client uses to hold them accountable for absences and undertime.
fact.quote: Kaya no, may attendance kayo sino absent, sino nag-undertime. I make them responsible. Pero imagine mo ha, o yan, i-picture ka sila. Takot. Binibigay nila yung accomplishment report nila.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client wants to replace her current tools with ADVO's app and says she will drop an app she no longer likes; she previously used a CRM whose company has since closed.
fact.quote: Basta ganun ako, pag ayaw ko na yung app, iiwan na kita. Hindi ko na... Nice naman ito yung infrastructure lang. Yung infrastructure lang kailangan ko. Pag binili ko yung iyo, pangkatahin ko na yung ginagamit ko.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The pipeline runs from quote to warranty and service (back jobs), and fabricators must be limited to seeing only project data, not customer data.
fact.quote: So, that's why service, Ilagay ko na rin dyan. However, If you're a fabricator, you cannot see the information or data. But you can only see probably the project data.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Coordinators, fabricators and installers share one pipeline but each sees only their part.
fact.quote: So although nasa isang pipeline kayo, may coordinator, may fabricator, may installer, hindi lahat. Ito lang.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client's current tournament Excel assigns players to courts (five courts), is very manual but organized, and was built by her as an accountant.
fact.quote: Maganda pag ano yung parang in-design niya naka-court na siya, auntie. Kasi isa po, limang court lang. Gano'n na lang. Very manual, pero maayos. Very manual lang eh, pero maayos. Proud ako dyan, ha? Wala niyo, ha? Magaling ako sa Excel.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The tournament template includes player classes A, B and C and T-shirt sizes.
fact.quote: Tapos, meron pa nga ako, T-shirt, ano sizes na mga Course summary. So class A, class B. So A, B, C.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client's tournaments use a 1-to-31 scoring system over four games, unlike the BWS 15-point format.
fact.quote: 1 to 31. 31. Apat na games. Nagulat ako hanggang 15 lang pala ang BWS ngayon.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: ADVO asked the client to send the tournament Excel files so it can build the cards.
fact.quote: Send nyo lang po yung excel file na. Send nyo lang po yung mga excel file. Para magawa ko yung cards na sila.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The tournament schedule gives equal rest and keeps all courts playing simultaneously, with each group fixed to one court.
fact.quote: Anorganize yung schedule nila. Para equal resting. And then all courts are playing at the same time. Walang tatawa ka, go to court 1, walang gaganoon. Kung past 8 ka, you would only use this court.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Speaker 1 (ADVO) will give the client access to Hypo, with two items: a tournament and the Google Sheet.
fact.quote: Okay. So, tigyan kita ng access sa Hypo. So, check mo kung kayo. Check ako. So, dalawa na. Isang tournament, tapos isang... Yung Google Shoot, yun ang ano. Tournament.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client's website has been revised and she asked who will update it when new windows, sites or products are added; ADVO said it can do the updates.
fact.quote: Ang concern ko lang naman ito rin, paano kung may kami naglalawa, tuturuan niya kami. Anong update po? Kunwari may bagong window, bagong site. May bagong product, sino mag-update?
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Marvin built the website product categories (aluminum and sub-categories) the client asked for.
fact.quote: Sa categories yung ina mo, tita, na gusto mo sa ima sa Marvin, yung like... Yung aluminum, tsaka yung under-aluminum, may ganito, may ganyan. Oo, nagawa niya? Apo, na ano naman.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The website door animation is wrong: the movement must be outward, not inward.
fact.quote: Hindi, inward movement. Yan ang mali. Ito? Should be outward movement.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The sleeve door is a slim indoor-only product, about 45 mm, used as a partition such as between bedroom and wardrobe.
fact.quote: Sobrang siyang nipis to 45 inches lang siya. Yung... Parang 45 siya dito. And 16 or 15. It's so slim that it looks like very...
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client will provide her own product photos and videos (sourced from China) as material for ADVO to build an animation instead of using the raw video.
fact.quote: Parang gumawa ka na ng animation dyan. Ah, siguro. Instead na emitting mo itong video.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO offers a basic tier (attendance only) and an advanced tier that adds sales and production.
fact.quote: Kapag gusto nyo ng basic or advance. Payroll. Yung basic kasi is attendance lang. Yung hiningi nyo. Kapag gusto nyo rin ng sales, ng production. Parang CRM?
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client wants the CRM kept separate from HRIS access because sales access is different.
fact.quote: Separate natin yung CRM. Iyan ko naman ilalagay sa Access and HRS. At sales, iba talaga ang access.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Initial scope is the basic tier: attendance with accomplishment report, plus applicant tracking.
fact.quote: Pero, attendance with accomplishment report. Apo. Saka by data siguro. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Hanggang dyan lang. And applicant. Apo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: A factory worker account should only be able to see its own data and never sales.
fact.quote: Pwede, pero if you're a factory worker, kunyari lang, you can only access your own. Opo. Hindi ka pwede nakakita ng sales. Yes.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO asserted there is no limit on data size because hosting and database are scalable.
fact.quote: Hindi po yan bibigas. Wala pong limit eh. Sure ka? Opo. 100%? Yes.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Hosting costs 3K a month including maintenance, database and hosting.
fact.quote: 3K a month po. Kamahal? May maintenance, tapos database, hosting. Gusto mo yung pagsama-sama lang? Up to you po.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client wants to start with the basic scope and add modules incrementally when ready, because she fears unnecessary data exposure across companies.
fact.quote: Eh what if ito muna, sasakan natin dagdagan. Until we're ready with that, idadagdagan. Pwede ba yun? Pwede ganun nyo lang. Kasi takot ako eh.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Modules a user has no access to are hidden entirely (no button), gated at the server by account level.
fact.quote: Wala na yung button na yun. Wala akong makikita doon. So, hindi mo malalaman kung anong meron doon. Yung makikita mo lang is yung sa'yo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Property and cars modules can be added to the same app but are not included in the current scope.
fact.quote: Opo. Yun din pa yung sinabi ko kanina. Pwede tayo mag-add dito ng property, pati yung cars. So, pwede na lahat? Opo. Tako. Tapos hindi naka-include dyan yung cars at yung real estate.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client wants an internal service-request module (e.g. broken lights, aircon) distinct from customer service in the CRM.
fact.quote: Ito kasi internal service. Within your company, you have to serve. Nasira ang ilaw, ilan yung air. Have you heard of, what do you call that internal?
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The system is hosted on Supabase, which ADVO says has about 99% uptime.
fact.quote: Sa infrastructure kasi ng Supabase. Parang 99% uptime. So, everyone kasi uses Subabase. E di syempre kung nagdown Subabase.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The monthly fee covers database, hosting, maintenance and domain.
fact.quote: Nakakasama na dyan lahat ng database, hosting, pati maintenance, pati domain.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Supabase tiers discussed are 2GB RAM (cheaper) or 4GB RAM, with 100 GB storage on the plan checked.
fact.quote: It's 2GB RAM kapag yung mura. Tapos may 4GB RAM. O ito, ano yung binibigyan? Ano po? Ilang database? Ilang storage? Ah, check natin. Ay, 100 GB siya.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client worries 100 GB may be insufficient and does not want to pay more; old data is to be archived or compressed instead.
fact.quote: Increase? Magbabayad pa? Kung ayoko na magbayad. O i-archive mo siya? Pwede rin. I think i-archive mo siya, Pag mga old data.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client's product warranty is 10 years, so data older than 10 years can be backed up and deleted.
fact.quote: 10 years lang naman kasi warranty natin.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client recalls an earlier ADVO estimate of 25 to 30 and asked for it to be lowered and for the system to be tested before she closes.
fact.quote: Para matest niya. Matest ko siya. Pero babaan niya na. Sabi niya sa akin dati 25 to 30 eh.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO said the 25-to-30 figure was a rough estimate now under review, and the client's biometrics will be tried with the system.
fact.quote: Ito yung rough estimate tita. Pero nung nireview na nila and ano. May biometrics din ko kasi. Susubukan. Susubukan.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client wants a clean product video that does not look Chinese and contains no people.
fact.quote: So bigay ko sa itong mag-video pero Syempre hindi magmukhang China. So kailangan mo gawin na medyo... Makikita siya clean, pero non-Chinese clean. Walang tao, kaya mo yun?
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Sliding casement is a new product that slides first and then becomes a casement.
fact.quote: O, ito'y bago. Sliding casement. Nag-slide muna siya bago siya naging casement. Gets mo? O, yan o. Nag-slide muna siya bago siya naging casement. Bagong product yan.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: SC door stands for slide and casement; the client also sells a stair glass railing not yet shown to ADVO.
fact.quote: Slide and casement. SC ang tawag yun, SC door. Ito yung ano namin, stair glass railing. Hindi nakikita eh.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The client will send SC door and glass railing assets and asked ADVO to fix the web content; she also sells a house line safety plug.
fact.quote: Gusto kong pakita sa inyo yung glass railing namin, Hindi kakaiba din natin. Add na lang kaya kita, Dave, dito. Sige po, mas easy. Saka meron din kasi yung house line. House line? Isa siyang plug na hindi ka makukuryente, Tapos pwede mo i-put yung plugs.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

decision.text: Tournament app is exclusive to Wingman and free for participants.
ADVO offers to build the customized fabrication software in place of the existing Indian vendor; not yet final.
Start with the basic tier (attendance with accomplishment report plus applicant tracking); CRM/sales/production kept separate and added later when the client is ready.
Role-gated access: factory workers, fabricators and installers see only their own or project data; unauthorized modules are hidden.
Hosting on Supabase at 3K per month covering database, hosting, maintenance and domain; scale storage by archiving/compressing, with data older than the 10-year warranty backed up and deleted.
The earlier 25-to-30 estimate is a rough estimate under review; client wants it lowered and tested with biometrics before closing.
Property and cars modules are not in current scope but can be added to the same app.

action.description: Send the tournament Excel files to ADVO so the cards/schedule can be built
Give the client access to Hypo (tournament and Google Sheet)
Fix the website door animation so the door moves outward
Send SC door, sliding casement, stair glass railing and house line photos/videos for the website and animation
Produce a clean, non-Chinese-looking product video/animation with no people
Review the rough 25-to-30 estimate and return an updated quote
Set up a system test including the client's biometrics
Confirm Supabase tier (2GB vs 4GB RAM, 100 GB storage) and archiving policy for data older than 10 years
Define tournament app requirements (players, pairing, schedule, captain score entry, rankings, class A/B/C, 1-to-31 scoring)
Update the website with new products when the client sends them

openQuestion.text: Will ADVO rebuild the licensed fabrication software, and what are the IP/licensing implications of the 6,000 euro license and a database wipe?
What is the revised project price after the 25-to-30 rough estimate review?
How are real estate, cars/LTO, internal service and CRM modules phased and priced after the basic HRIS?
What is the storage expansion policy beyond 100 GB, and who pays for increases?
What is 'Hypo' and what exactly will the client be given access to?
